two_factor.title: Verification code
two_factor.description: Insite Energy has emailed a verification code to {username}. Enter it below. This browser is then remembered for 45 days, so you should not be asked again until then. Tick "Send a new code" if one has not arrived.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Insite Energy
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant could not sign in as {username}. Enter the current password. If Insite Energy asks for a verification code, you will be prompted for one next.

error.code_resent: A new code has been sent - check your inbox.
error.invalid_code: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
error.resend_failed: Could not send a new code. Cancel and start again to get a fresh one.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Insite Energy account can be configured

init.title: Configure Insite Energy
init.description: Adjust integration settings. Each discovered utility gets its own weight field ({utilities}): pick a statistic whose activity that utility's readings should follow, or leave it blank to spread each reading evenly across the period it covers. Do not pick this integration's own insite_energy statistics, or the meter reading sensors this integration creates.

data.password: Password (leave blank to keep the current one)

refresh_data.name: Refresh data
refresh_data.description: Forces a fetch of the latest data from Insite Energy.
